text_en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines, and many fell on Mount Gilboa.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人攻打以色列人，以色列人由培肋舍特人面前逃走，在基耳波亚山上阵亡的人很多。

text_en: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人随后追击撒乌耳和他的儿子，杀了撒乌耳的儿子约纳堂、阿彼纳达布和玛耳基叔亚；

text_en: The battle pressed hard upon Saul; the archers found him, and he was badly wounded by them.
text_cn: 以后，集中攻打撒乌耳，弓手射中了他，伤势很重。

text_en: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, so that these uncircumcised may not come and thrust me through, and make sport of me. ” But his armor-bearer was unwilling; for he was terrified. So Saul took his own sword and fell upon it.
text_cn: 当时撒乌耳对自己的执戟者说：“拔出你的剑来，将我刺死，免得这些未受割损的人来刺死我，侮辱我！”但是执戟者十分害怕，不肯作这事。于是撒乌耳拔出剑来，伏剑自刎。

text_en: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his sword and died with him.
text_cn: 执戟者见撒乌耳已死，也伏剑自刎，和他同死了。

text_en: So Saul and his three sons and his armor-bearer and all his men died together on the same day.
text_cn: 这样，撒乌耳和他的三个儿子，以及执戟者都在一天一同阵亡了。

text_en: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley and those beyond the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their towns and fled; and the Philistines came and occupied them.
text_cn: 住在平原和住在约但河那边的以色列人，看见以色列人逃散了，撒乌耳和他的儿子们阵亡了，就都弃城逃走；培肋舍特人遂来住在那里。

text_en: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
text_cn: 次日，培肋舍特人前来剥取阵亡者的衣服时，发现撒乌耳和他的三个儿子也阵亡在基耳波亚山上。

text_en: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to carry the good news to the houses of their idols and to the people.
text_cn: 他们就砍下撒乌耳的头，取去他的武器，送到培肋舍特各地，向他们的神和人民传报这喜信：

text_en: They put his armor in the temple of Astarte; and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.
text_cn: 把他的武器放在阿市托勒特庙内，将他的尸首悬在贝特商城墙上。

text_en: But when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
text_cn: 基肋阿得雅贝士的居民，一听说培肋舍特人对撒乌耳所行的一切，

text_en: all the valiant men set out, traveled all night long, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan. They came to Jabesh and burned them there.
text_cn: 所有的勇士就动身，走了一夜，从贝特商城墙上取下撒乌耳和他儿子们的尸体，带回雅贝士，在那里焚烧了。

text_en: Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
text_cn: 然后将他们的骨骸收敛起来，埋在雅贝士柽(chēng)柳下，禁食七天。
